summary: Centerra Gold Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing its Board of Directors approved a quarterly dividend of C$0.07 per common share, totaling approximately C$13.9 million or US$10.0 million. The dividend is payable on June 4, 2026, to shareholders of record on May 21, 2026. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation. No M&A, activist campaign, restructuring, or other event is disclosed. The filing is a foreign private issuer's periodic report. No deal terms or special-situation mechanics apply.
